text:
Mikko Rantanen has 28 points in 24 games for Dallas, and his best night came in Vegas on Nov. 17, when his four points led a comeback that Yahoo Sports summed up as reminding the Golden Knights that no lead is safe. Over his last ten games he has 11 points, right where we'd expect at his ice time.

The season line is carrying more luck than most. He has 10 goals on 6.5 expected goals (the quality of his chances), shooting 22% against 16% last season, and Dallas has scored 7.8 more goals than expected with him on the ice. His own chance creation is down too: 0.81 expected goals per 60 minutes, under last season's 1.02, and his ice time has slipped by about two-thirds of a minute lately. What's still clearly there is the skating, with a top speed in the 98th percentile on NHL Edge. Our numbers project about 93 points. Watch the shot count: 45 in 24 games is low for a player of his size and touch.
headline: Rantanen's finishing is running ahead of him
